heroIntro: Monthly payroll with compliant salary files, correct gratuity and clean records for labour compliance reviews.
overview: UAE payroll depends on getting the Wage Protection System (WPS) file right every month and calculating end-of-service gratuity and leave correctly when people leave. We handle both, and keep payroll records ready for labour compliance reviews.
whatWeDo: Run monthly payroll with allowances, deductions and overtime.
Generate WPS salary files for your bank or exchange house.
Calculate end-of-service gratuity and leave encashment.
Handle joiners, exits and final settlements.
Maintain records for labour compliance reviews.

byPlan.cfo: Up to 50 employees. More are priced per head.

note: Payroll is reported in AED, with INR views available if you also operate in India.
